verdict.rationale: Microsoft Graph documents a first-party driveItem search API that queries items across a folder hierarchy, a whole drive, or files shared with the user, so a documented search API exists. The evidence never states whether matching covers full-text file content or only filenames and metadata, so the core 'reaches inside files' claim is unproven. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that search matches full-text file content beyond filenames, details of query semantics (non-prefix matching), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, search reaches inside files — a documented search API over filenames and full-text content, not just prefix matching

citations.quote: Search the hierarchy of items for items matching a query. You can search within a folder hierarchy, a whole drive, or files shared with the current user.
You can use Microsoft Graph to create an app that connects with files across OneDrive, OneDrive for Business, and SharePoint document libraries
